label: Late copy steps of short (L=3/4) sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never on original-token or delimiter steps, and never on a token appearing for the first time. Most of its mass (~59%) comes from L=3 sequences at copy steps 4 and 5 (outputting orig(1) and orig(2)). There it is active about 79% of the time, and the step-5 activation (input orig(1), two steps after <DEL>) is about twice the step-4 activation. A second component is L=4 at recall_idx 2 (input orig(1)), which only fires for some input tokens (g, p, i, n, u, 2, 3, ...). Weak, scattered activations near the end of longer sequences (to_go<=1, e.g. t=11-13 and t=17) are not captured. It is gated by the two-steps-after-<DEL> position in short sequences plus token identity. Dev F1 is 0.60 and mass recall 0.77.
